lineage.strategy: Replace independent foundry reporting with the definitive primary IBM/Anderon award announcement and preserve commercialization unknowns.

observations.fact: Anderon finalized a $1 billion CHIPS Act award with the U.S. Department of Commerce; IBM is backing the 300mm quantum-wafer foundry with an additional $1 billion investment.
IBM says first quantum wafers are already running through the facility, supporting superconducting qubit arrays, quantum I/O signaling and readout-chain components.

risks.risk: Award finalization and initial wafer processing demonstrate funded manufacturing execution, not external customer demand, yield, utilization, fault tolerance or economic returns.

unknowns.unknown: External customers, foundry utilization, wafer yields, award milestone economics and realized quantum revenue remain undisclosed in the primary release.

recommendation: Use this definitive primary source to replace the weaker independent lineage for foundry execution; keep commercialization and return assumptions unscored until sourced.
